items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Do you know an H. Lenk?

ctx.x: And he is the only one who ever wrote lyrics. And then you showed me a 78 record of Woody Herman and the New Third Herd recording of Perdido, and on that record, the composer credits, in addition to yourself and Ervin Drake, lists an H. Lenk. Do you know an H. Lenk? Did he have anything to do with Perdido or the lyrics?
